intro: A Stormwind Armor Marker is an official military requisition token issued to adventurers who have aided the realm. It can be redeemed with sanctioned artisans, such as Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp, in exchange for freshly crafted gear.

p: Maintaining law and order across Elwynn Forest stretches the resources of the realm thin. Rather than distributing standard gear directly from military outposts, commanders sometimes issue official tokens known as armor markers. These requisition slips verify that the bearer has performed valorous service for Stormwind and authorize local contracted craftsmen to supply them with tailored armor.

One key destination for these markers is the Eastvale Logging Camp, situated on the eastern frontier of Elwynn. There, artisans like Sara Timberlain operate under commission from the Stormwind Army, turning local materials into protective cloth and leather garments. Presenting a marker grants recruits custom-fitted defense to aid them in safeguarding the surrounding woodlands.
